summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Dimensional US Large Cap Vector ETF (DFVX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund does not seek to track an index. The portfolio contains broad exposure to US large-cap stocks, actively selected based on fundamental criteria and managed for long-term capital appreciation. DFVX was launched on Nov 1, 2023 and is issued by Dimensional.

holdings.infoBox: DFVX is an equity ETF with a total of 334 individual holdings. The top holdings are Microsoft stock at 6.52%, Alphabet at 5.35%, Meta Platforms at 5.28%, Amazon.com at 5.13%, and Micron Technology at 2.53%.
